LanguageData.NR_AIQ_Terms: {0} days after accepting. Failing costs 15 trust and the service for 3 days; letting the offer lapse costs 5 trust. The first quest takes the AI to level 2 (+25% service), the third to level 3 (a second service).
LanguageData.NR_AIQ_JokeText: {0} offers a joke: a gift, a prank, or both?
LanguageData.NR_AIQ_PrankDone: {0} pulled its prank: the net heard about the colony for a moment.
LanguageData.NR_AIQ_GiftFound: The gift of {0} was waiting in the branch.
LanguageData.NR_AIQ_Level_2: {0} trusts the colony more: its service is 25% stronger and its traits are open.
LanguageData.NR_AIQ_Level_3: {0} has opened up completely: a second service is available.
LanguageData.NR_AIQ_Legend: {0} has found itself in an old recording and remembers who it was. The colony will tell this story for a long time.
LanguageData.NR_AIQ_NoMercs: No mercenary raid is on its way: the forecast found nothing to delay.
LanguageData.NR_AIQ_MercsDelayed: The next mercenary raid is delayed: it comes in {0}.
LanguageData.NR_AI2News_Ghost: Someone pinned a fresh trace on {0}.
LanguageData.NR_AI2News_Trickster: {0} spent a day chasing a fake lead.
LanguageData.NR_AI2Tip: Second service of a level-3 AI. Once in {0} days.
LanguageData.NR_AILevelTip: Level {0} (quests done: {1}). Level 2 after the first quest: service +25%, traits open. Level 3 after the third: a second service.
LanguageData.NR_AITraitDesc_Remembering: + Remembers who it was: trust grows 10% faster.\n− Nothing.
LanguageData.NR_AIQ_Desc_AnotherName: {0} wants to vanish for a while and come back under another name.
LanguageData.NR_AIQ_AnotherName_Step1: Keep Heat in the Shadow for 5 days in a row.
LanguageData.NR_AIQ_AnotherName_Step2: Dive into a deserted or rival-touched branch and leave without an ICE hit.
LanguageData.NR_AIQ_Desc_AnotherMemory: {0} wants to feel something {1} through a human mind.
LanguageData.NR_AIQ_AnotherMemory_Step2: Edit it into a chip of good quality.
LanguageData.NR_AIQ_Retaliation_Step1: Repel an intrusion while {0} is online.
LanguageData.NR_AIQ_Desc_Drills: {0} wants to see what the colony's hub can take.
LanguageData.NR_AIQ_Drills_Step2: Stop an intrusion with an intercept on the backbone.
LanguageData.NR_AIQ_Desc_Forecast: {0} has seen something in the numbers: {1}.
LanguageData.NR_AIQ_Forecast_Step1: Dive into {0} within 2 days, while the forecast holds.
LanguageData.NR_AIQ_Desc_MissingPart: {0} needs a body bigger than one server.
LanguageData.NR_AIQ_MissingPart_Step1: Build an AI coprocessor or a server rack.
LanguageData.NR_AIQ_MissingPart_Step2: Hand over 5 advanced components (taken from storage).
LanguageData.NR_AIQ_Desc_ChoiceOfJoke: {0} has a joke for the colony. Or a gift. Or both.
LanguageData.NR_AIQ_ChoiceOfJoke_Step1: Choose: a gift, a prank, or both (a letter).
LanguageData.NR_AIQ_ChoiceOfJoke_Step2: Find the gift in the next clean dive.
LanguageData.NR_AIQ_Patient_Step1: Bring {0}'s Netsick down to a light stage.
LanguageData.NR_AIQ_Desc_MissingVolume: {0} is missing one volume from its archive.
LanguageData.NR_AIQ_MissingVolume_Step1: Make a special find in an archive branch.
LanguageData.NR_AIQ_FirstStep_Step1: Feed it one way for a few days.
LanguageData.NR_AIQ_FirstStep_Step2: Dive with it in the pod's coprocessor.
LanguageData.NR_AIQ_Desc_WhoAmI: {0} wants to remember who it was.
LanguageData.NR_AIQ_WhoAmI_Step1: Have a braindance recording made by the one it was.
LanguageData.NR_AIQ_Desc_ForeignCode: {0} senses another mind in the net.
LanguageData.NR_AIQ_ForeignCode_Step1: Dive into a node with a wild AI.
LanguageData.NR_AI2Desc_DataHunter: Reveals a forgotten cache in a known branch.
LanguageData.NR_AI2Desc_Ghost: Moves 15 Heat onto a rival crew.
LanguageData.NR_AI2Desc_Muse: A colonist gets an inspiration of creativity.
LanguageData.NR_AI2Desc_Predator: Strikes an incoming intrusion before it arrives: it is stopped.
LanguageData.NR_AI2Desc_Warden: Closes the path of an incoming intrusion for 6 hours.
LanguageData.NR_AI2Desc_Oracle: Shows which corporation will strike next, and when.
LanguageData.NR_AI2Desc_Forge: A day of research done at once.
LanguageData.NR_AI2Desc_Trickster: A rival crew wastes a day chasing a lie: they lose fame.
LanguageData.NR_AI2Desc_Doc: Removes a cyberspace coma or lockout from one colonist.
LanguageData.NR_AI2Desc_Archivist: A colonist learns a level of a random skill.
LanguageData.NR_AI2Desc_Echo: Takes away one colonist's grief over a death.
